title: What is populism?
goal: Learn how Latin American populism is usually defined, what features historians point to, and why the word is disputed.

items: I can say how Latin American populism is usually defined.
I can name the features that historians point to in these movements.
I can explain why experts disagree about the word populism.
I can describe the situation these movements grew out of.
I can use impersonal se (se suele, se dice que) to report a general view.
